Each retained page was individually parsed for decision date, legislation and outcome.
source_reviews.gap_reason: The court reports are a complete accessible electrical candidate set for this pass after materiality filtering. Generic WHS machinery and fall-protection matters are excluded even where a machine was de-energised, an employer was solar-related, or the injured worker was an electrician. Many retained pages intentionally omit the defendant name, so the public case is indexed by official report URL and decision date rather than inferred identity.
